reserveText: Our babies find homes quickly. Reach out to reserve your furever friend or to ask questions by filling out the form. You are welcome to call me directly for a quicker response.

deposit.note: Deposits are required to be on the waiting list or to hold a puppy. A $15 fee is added for processing online payments. No fee is added to Venmo (@Sandie-Dowell) or Zelle (817-944-4750).
